Source: 0 disables the failsafe. 1 enables failsafe on loss of RC input. This is detected either by the throttle channel reaching THR_FS_VALUE (at or below it, or at or above it for a reversed throttle channel), loss of receiver valid pulses/data, or by the FS bit in receivers that provide it, like SBUS. A programmable failsafe action will occur and RC inputs, if present, will be ignored. A value of 2 means that the RC inputs won't be used when RC failsafe is detected by any of the above methods, but it won't trigger an RC failsafe action.
ReviewStatus: Reviewed against the exact source text; firmware availability remains version specific
Translation: 0：停用此失效保護。1：啟用遙控輸入遺失的失效保護。偵測條件包括油門通道達到 THR_FS_VALUE（一般通道為小於或等於；反向油門通道為大於或等於）、接收機有效脈波／資料遺失，或 SBUS 等接收機提供的 FS 位元。觸發後會執行設定的失效保護動作，並忽略仍存在的 RC 輸入。2：以上述任一方式偵測到 RC 失效時忽略 RC 輸入，但不觸發 RC 失效保護動作。

Source: Allows setting an individual MAVLink system id for this vehicle to distinguish it from others on the same network. IDs above 255 require MAVLink2 with 32-bit system ID support on every communicating device. MAVLink1 ports cannot transmit with these IDs.

Source: Glitch offsets of simulated GPS velocity in NED. The reported position also moves continuously with this velocity, so position and velocity stay consistent (e.g. to simulate GPS spoofing that drifts the position). The accumulated position offset is cleared when all three components are zero at a GPS update, so when changing axes set the new component before zeroing the old one (X-axis)
ReviewStatus: Reviewed against the exact source text; firmware availability remains version specific
Translation: 模擬 GPS 在 NED 座標系的速度突變偏移量（X 軸）。回報的位置也會隨此速度持續移動，使位置與速度保持一致，例如模擬讓位置漂移的 GPS 欺騙。當一次 GPS 更新時三個分量皆為 0，累積的位置偏移會清除；因此切換軸向時，應先設定新分量，再將原分量歸零。

Source: Height below which the navigation velocity gain is left at full scale while navigating on optical flow. Above it the gain falls as this value divided by the height above ground, to allow for flow velocity noise that grows with height. Larger values keep position hold more responsive at height, at more risk of a flow-driven oscillation. Values below 1 are treated as 1. Takes effect immediately.
ReviewStatus: Reviewed against the exact source text; firmware availability remains version specific
Translation: 使用光流導航時，在此離地高度以下，導航速度增益維持全值；高於此高度時，增益依「此值／離地高度」衰減，以因應隨高度增加的光流速度雜訊。較大的值可讓高處的位置保持反應較靈敏，但增加光流造成振盪的風險。小於 1 的值按 1 處理。變更立即生效。

This can be used to detect the RC transmitter going out of range. Failsafe will be triggered when the throttle channel reaches the FS_THR_VALUE, or goes below it, for FS_TIMEOUT seconds.

Source: This sets what MAVLink source system IDs are accepted for GCS failsafe handling, RC overrides and manual control. When MAV_GCS_SYSID_HI is less than MAV_GCS_SYSID then only this value is considered to be a GCS. When MAV_GCS_SYSID_HI is greater than or equal to MAV_GCS_SYSID then the range of values between MAV_GCS_SYSID and MAV_GCS_SYSID_HI (inclusive) are all treated as valid GCS MAVLink system IDs.
ReviewStatus: Reviewed against the exact source text; firmware availability remains version specific
Translation: 設定哪些 MAVLink 來源系統 ID 可用於地面站失效保護處理、RC 覆寫及手動控制。當 MAV_GCS_SYSID_HI 小於 MAV_GCS_SYSID 時，只有本參數的值被視為地面站 ID；當 MAV_GCS_SYSID_HI 大於或等於 MAV_GCS_SYSID 時，兩者之間的所有 ID（包含上下限）都被視為有效的地面站 MAVLink 系統 ID。
